visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro: The scene opens with a wide shot of the red Sapporo TV Tower under an overcast sky. A digital clock on the tower reads 10:25. Large pink text overlays introduce the topic of Hokkaido soup curry. The ground is covered in patches of white snow, and several people are walking on the sidewalk. (2) Restaurant 1 - Okushiba Shoten: The camera pans to a rustic restaurant entrance with corrugated metal walls. Inside, the woman eats a chicken leg from a bowl of dark curry. The lighting is warm and indoor. Close-up shots show the texture of the meat and the steam from the soup. (3) Restaurant 2 - SOUL STORE: A green door with a logo is shown. The curry here has a lighter, creamier broth and a prominent piece of fried burdock. The camera zooms in on a spoon lifting the broth. The atmosphere is more modern than the first spot. (4) Restaurant 3 - RAMAI: This location features a dark, exotic Balinese-style interior with carved wood screens. The curry is packed with colorful vegetables like eggplant and green peppers. A scoop of yellow rice is served on the side. The lighting is dim and atmospheric. (5) Outro: A pink screen displays the Japanuts logo along with icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Text encourages viewers to check the link in the bio for more information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 北海道 必吃湯咖哩 3選. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Subtitle]: 來到北海道 一定要吃道地的湯咖哩. (2) [Logo]: 1 奧芝商店. [Subtitle]: 這間以蝦湯底聞名. 我點了午餐套餐的雞肉湯咖哩. 先來一口濃郁的湯 真的好好喝啊. 雞肉超軟嫩 用湯匙攪一下就碎開了 燉到入口即化，超讚的. (3) [Logo]: 2 SOUL STORE. [Subtitle]: 這家連兩年入選百名店. 每碗都有炸牛蒡，很有特色. 湯頭顏色偏淺 辣度很溫和，但不減濃郁. 這裡的雞腿也超讚 拜託你們一定要吃吃看. 店鋪在二樓 狸小路七丁目商店街內. (4) [Logo]: 3 RAMAI. [Subtitle]: 這間的外觀不像一般日本餐廳 裡面濃濃的峇里島風情. 我點了豆腐蔬菜咖哩 滿滿一碗超級豐富. 辣度3適合吃小辣的我 清爽蔬菜配上濃郁湯頭，絕讚. (5) [Slogan]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結. [Logo]: japanuts.com.
